subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should built-in compaction drop aborted assistant tool-call turns with missing results, matching the prompt-send sanitizer, instead of synthesizing missing tool results?
rationale: Both policies can produce provider-valid transcripts, but they preserve different session-state semantics for interrupted tool calls, so automation should not choose the permanent behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge this PR as the narrow fix: aborted partial tool-call turns are removed before compaction summarization to avoid poisoning strict providers.

options.title: Require synthetic interrupted result
options.body: Ask for a revision that keeps the assistant turn and inserts an explicit interrupted result instead of dropping the turn.

options.title: Pause for broader repair policy
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers settle a single cross-path transcript repair policy for aborted, errored, and missing-result turns.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the narrow fix: aborted partial tool-call turns are removed before compaction summarization to avoid poisoning strict providers.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history in the session transcript repair area that defines this policy boundary.
